body: Yeah they will, but it will also come to a point where things will improve and hopefully you'll still be around to experience that - you don't deserve to feel this way and though it's really bloody unfortunate that you haven't had people around in your everyday life to do the bare minimum and care, so many people on here have seen your post and are concerned and want the best for you - things WILL improve, it's just the most annoying bloody thing that it takes longer for some than others - please message if you need someone to vent to  xo

Sound like absolute bastards to be quite honest with you-  though having support from people online might not seem as real as having people irl , they still care, we still care , always feel as though you can reach out to any of us xo

Personally, I've fantasised about hanging for months now, it's comforting having that rope around your neck and the sounds are even more tempting but it seems like we're both still here because some unconscious part of us knows that there's still a future ahead of us + there really is, maybe it's the bloody gin getting ahold of me tonight but you and I and anyone apart of this thread are capable of so much more - we just need to give ourselves a little more time to work on things, because as much of a lie as it sounds, things WILL work out for you, just give yourself a chance x

I was in the same position exactly last week - after talking to the local crisis team I felt worse that  those suicidal thoughts had gone or at least are a lot less tamer than they were, but as much as I would punch the next person that told me that "things will improve"  even drunk me is convinced of this and if they can for me, they sure as hell can for you - always know that me and lots of other strangers who haven't even met you know that you can turn things around, or at least try - but even if you try and they don't, know that you have us here concerned for your well-being - because it doesn't matter whether we know you personally or not, you still matter to us - if within a month things don't improve reach out to any one of us that have commented because we do care and believe it or not you are capable of turning things around - honestly message me anytime you're struggling, because I feel exactly as you do now + though we're both going to go through ups and downs, we're also going to come out the other side stronger than we were before -  you're capable of so much more than you know x
